  "pros": [
    "Simple and effective for managing task lists and project deadlines.",
    "Clear descriptions for tools like To-dos and Calendar make it easy to get started.",
    "The Card Table provides a visual way to track project statuses."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "The free plan's limitation to a single project is restrictive for multiple workstreams.",
    "Manual addition of tools and configuration steps introduce initial friction.",
    "Event defaults require manual adjustment for all-day deadlines, adding extra steps."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This self-employed entrepreneur likely found Basecamp to be a straightforward tool for basic task and project management. While its simplicity was appreciated for tracking individual projects, the limitations of the free plan and the need for manual configuration of tools might have been frustrating for someone managing diverse investment banking tasks. The platform's ease of use for core functions probably balanced out some of the initial setup friction and feature limitations."
